input_composition.normalization: Inline S->A and C->B; alias terminals Ta,Tb and group D->C Ta; append an explicit negative-epsilon guard to every binary production. No generic normalization routine is invoked.

source_rules: S -> S A & not(C b) | A
steps: Introduce Ta -> a and Tb -> b.
Introduce D -> C Ta, so Ta D represents a C a.
Inline S -> A as S -> Ta A | b.
Inline C -> B as C -> B A | b.
Add an explicit negative-epsilon guard to every binary production. The source grammar is nonnullable, so its language is preserved.
normalization.scope: This named grammar only; no general grammar-normalization algorithm or equivalence decision is claimed.
normalization.semantics: All binary rules include not(epsilon); every accepted component of a split has positive length, so nonempty membership is determined from shorter substrings.
normalization.ambiguity: Positive parse trees represent only positive components. Definition-5 diagnostics also inspect every positive and negative concatenation, including rejected strings.

snapshot.zero_default: Absent pair/rule/nonterminal rows mean exact zero. Every nonempty substring cell is in the declared domain.

summary.occurrence_order: Increasing substring length, then increasing zero-based start; positions are distinct occurrences.
summary.scope: Only nonempty substring occurrences of this supplied word. Positive parse uniqueness is not Boolean or inherent unambiguity.

result.scope: A ranked positive parse certificate with retained negative guards. Its uniqueness does not establish Boolean or inherent unambiguity.

execution_boundary.complete_domain: All 26,796 nonempty substring occurrences of the one 231-symbol input, not every alphabet word through that length.
execution_boundary.sparse_record_semantics: All 160,776 cell/pair entries are represented: the 5,402 nonzero split/count rows are explicit, all absent rows are exact zero. All positive and negative conjuncts are included even when their enclosing rule rejects.
execution_boundary.saved_open_checks: Loaded all cells and sparse records, checked split-mask support, 348,348 rule guards against saved masks, additive rule-to-nonterminal counts, summary totals, all occurrence indices and both complete finite diagnostic lists.
execution_boundary.saved_open_premises: It did not regenerate any child-membership convolution or multiplicative pair/rule parse count, establish external provenance or authenticate the input source.
execution_boundary.actual_query_arithmetic: 20 calls performed 11 occurrence binary steps and 238 weight products; positive parse certificates returned 474 nodes in two DAGs.
execution_boundary.scalar_reuse: The accepted 24 factorial exponents were copied as block lengths. No valuation, divisor, prime or prior grammar calculation was replayed.
execution_boundary.source_inspected_only: Empty word, other grammars, maximum caps, ambiguous grammar inputs and remaining rejection paths.
execution_boundary.interpretation: Finite membership/navigation and Definition-5 diagnostics on these substrings. No global Boolean-unambiguity, inherent-ambiguity, complexity, novelty or external-frontier claim.
execution_boundary.time_measurements: Single observed elapsed values, not statistical benchmarks.
